title: Mixed Event — On This Holy Night, I Sing — Episode2 Phoenix Stage Investigation

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing
meta.Event Outline: For their second show for the Show Contest, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS are preparing a Christmas-themed musical! However, a prima donna with a voice powerful enough to shock even Nene stands in their path...! Curtains open for these two songstresses as they each put their pride on the line!

rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm, I wouldn't have guessed this is how the play would end. I think it's good.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it's a great story. True to the Christmas spirit.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I'm pleased to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sort of starting to look forward to it. It's been such a long time since I was in a musical.

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: G-GUYS...!! You won't believe this...!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What happened, Emu? Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I went to see what the Phoenix Stage group is doing for the next round and... It's a Christmas musical too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They have the highest score so far, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! What a coincidence, huh?
I was super surprised!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But isn't it cool that we get to see a Christmas show done by someone else too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, this is terrible news for us!
The same exact theme...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll be in direct competition for the same crowd! This is bad... Can we go with something else, or is it too late?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I figured that this might happen, given that it's so close to Christmas, so I don't think it's a problem.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Making sudden changes to our play just because someone else is doing something similar wouldn't be good either, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't argue with that... If we are to win, we should do so by standing up to our rivals.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On the other hand, leaving this situation to unfold as it may also seems dangerous.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then what do you propose?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A secret investigation of the Phoenix Stage!
Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sneaky sneaky...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sneak sneak sneak....
Captain, I've successfully infiltrated the Phoenix Stage!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What a jolly little spying mission...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Emu, keep it down...!
We're trying to keep a low profile!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Look who's talking. Keep YOUR voice down or someone will notice.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I knew this stage was better than ours, but I wasn't expecting this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: This is the biggest stage in the park! Its troupe has the most actors and the hall can fit more people than anywhere else.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it had some renovations done recently, so it looks a little different than it used to...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph! I don't like this... These guys are getting more votes than anyone else probably because they get to use this gorgeous building!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you know what?! A real star doesn't need a fancy... I mean, a gaudy stage like this to shine! They're going to learn this the hard way!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What did I say about keeping your voice down?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Look, they're starting a rehearsal.
Their cast is far bigger than in ours...
Is everyone ready? We're starting with the opening number.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oooh! They're gonna sing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wonder what their songs are like...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Gasp...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Her voice is... Incredible...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Not only is her technique better than mine, her voice really resonates.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(It's not like she's just good at singing...
She's completely immersed in her role too.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! She's sparkling up there...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, now... I didn't suspect that they had a singer of her caliber. She must be their prima donna.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... I hate to admit it, but she's good...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She was amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I can't do what she just did...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, that was pretty good...
As it is, this is going to be tough for us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... Probably...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's get back to our stage and talk strategy...
I thought I saw someone spying on us. Have you come to check us out, Wonderlands×Showtime? Did you like what you saw?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You're that girl from before...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're the singing Phoenix Stage girl!
Hm? Don't tell me you don't even know my name?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?
I'm Sakurako Seiryuin, the prima donna of the Phoenix Stage!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Which obviously means I am the best performer in all of Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: How can you call yourselves theater people and not recognize me?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You think very highly of yourself...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! She's just like you, Tsukasa♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I apologize for this intrusion, but we were simply curious about what you, the top group, were working on this time.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Ah... You must be Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? I find it a pleasant surprise that you know me.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But of course. I make a habit of seeing all the shows in the park. I've seen a few of yours as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You've seen our shows?! Yay! I'm so happy!
How were they? Did you like them?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: The direction was good. What always seems randomly thrown together at first turns out to be all carefully tied together in the end like a real show.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But that's where it stops...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: The acting was dynamic but without finesse. It's very amateurish and can't compare to us!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I also was told that you also plan to do a Christmas musical?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
With you as the lead... Kusanagi was it?
She has some talent for singing but...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'm sure you can see that we're in a totally different league! One or two good songs would still leave your chances of winning at zero!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's right...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I can't sing the way she does...
She puts everything into every note.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I can't match that... )

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Just make it so that your show doesn't bring any shame to the park. Now, if you'll excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You... You...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You snooty brat!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: W-What did you just call me?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Our stage may look like something that could get blown away by a strong breeze, but our shows are the crème de la crème!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And you're wrong if you think Nene can't sing as well as you!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Oh my. With such a hothead for a leader, it's no wonder your shows are the way they are...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You just keep playing pretend while you let the real stars shine!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: T-That's enough...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tsukasa may be an idiot, but you have no right calling our shows pretend or anything...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're not going to lose... N-Not to someone like you...!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Hmph....
We'll see about that in the next round.

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Ms. Seiryuin! The break is almost over!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Excuse me, Wonder Stage crew. You seem like all bark and no bite, but prove me wrong IF you can!
